narrative: Material PL1__MF6E6E72 shows erratic but near-Normal daily demand averaging 10,706 units with a CV of 0.21 over 128 working days from March 2025 to March 2026. Lead times are stable at a mean of 5.84 days (CV=0.19). The (r,Q) EOQ policy is selected: safety stock is set to 21,479 units (z=1.645 at 95% SL applied to sigma_LTD=13,058), which is 27.4% below the current SAP buffer of 29,577, reducing annual holding costs while fully maintaining the service level target.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is near-Normal (CV=0.21, erratic but not intermittent) and lead times are stable (CV=0.19), making the classical EOQ-based (r,Q) policy the cost-minimising choice. It delivers a closed-form safety stock guarantee and minimises the sum of ordering and holding costs without requiring more complex stochastic or MILP models.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage utilisation after replenishment is 43.4% (62,991 of 145,187 units). No capacity constraint binds. The MOQ of 2,070 is well below the EOQ of 41,512 and does not distort the policy.
